text:
ana: Heads-up — BrightCart dedicated pool in eu-west-2 is oscillating. We see scale-up -> scale-down churn every ~3m, customers reporting intermittent 429s and higher token billing.

mike: saw that on the grafana alert too. pattern looks periodic, not constant noisy-neighbor CPU spike.

sam-ops: any recent deploys to that pool? infra-bot: no infra deploys in last 12h.

ana: typo, meant ana :stuck_out_tongue:  — no deploys. logs show throttles at the inference gateway right as scaler triggers.

jess: can you paste the main metrics? GPU_util, instance_count, scale events?

ana: copying quick snippet from grafana:
```
time, gpu_util, instances
18:03, 12, 1
18:05, 78, 4  <- scale up
18:08, 15, 1  <- scale down shortly after
18:11, 80, 4
18:14, 18, 1
```

mike: that looks like the scaler jumps on short p95 blips. cooldown is currently 120s. autoscaler is using instant max GPU_util.

sam-ops: customer report: "we get 429 for 10-30s, then it's fine" — matches short-lived pressure.

jess: likely root cause: reactive policy + short bursts means scaler overprovisions then drops before KV cache / warmup completes -> new requests get 429s during transition. Also billing spikes because of rapid adds.

ana: repro steps from support-bot (BrightCart):
1) run steady 50 qps for 20s then stop for 40s (repeat)
2) watch /v1/predict returning 429s during ramp
Example curl load:
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://inference.br.redwood/v1/predict & done
```

mike: mitigation ideas: increase cooldown to 600s, set min_instances=2 for that customer, or change metric to 5m avg (ema) instead of instant max.

sam-ops: agree. also consider gating by qps token bucket to smooth input to the pool so scaler makes better decisions.

jess: quick experiment: set scaler.policy.metric = avg_over_time(gpu_util[5m]) and cooldown=600s, min=2 for brightcart-eu-west-2. If stable for 30m rollback.

ana: doing change now (manual override) — will post results. infra-bot: applied config change to brightcart-eu-west-2: cooldown=600s, min_instances=2, metric=5m_avg.

mike: monitoring — created temp dashboard: p95 latency, 429 rate, instance_count, gpu_util 1m/5m. link: https://grafana.internal/r/BR-osc-123

sam-ops: alert tweaks: suppress repeated scale alerts for 20m after first noisy-suppression.

ana: immediate after change: scale events dropped, p95 latency improved but 429s continued for one ramp cycle (expected while new instances warm).

jess: long term: we should add smoothing to autoscaler (EMA) + warmup signals (kv_cache_ready) so scaler holds once it ramps until warmup flag clears. filing follow-up to eng-runtime.

ana: opened ticket ENG-5234 with notes + traces + reproduction script. assigning to @mike for follow-up.

mike: ack. will take on the ticket and prototype EMA smoothing with a configurable half-life.

support-bot: updated BrightCart with temporary mitigations and ETA for permanent fix: 48h. customer says :thumbsup: for now.

jess: nice work. we'll watch for 1h, if stable we'll close this thread. thanks all :heart:
